source: CAMS Europe + CAMS Global via Open-Meteo Air Quality API
air_quality_rule: Worst European AQI pollutant sub-index determines module risk. EEA Good+Fair -> GREEN, Moderate -> YELLOW, Poor -> ORANGE, Very poor -> RED, Extremely poor -> PURPLE.
uv_rule: Maximum hourly UVI in each 3-hour slot; <3 GREEN, <6 YELLOW, <8 ORANGE, <11 RED, >=11 PURPLE.
dust_rule: Dust is diagnostic/context only in v1 and does not independently raise the air-quality risk.
